claimOwner().details: Allows the nominated owner to claim ownership of the contract. Throws an error if the caller is not the nominee. Sets the nominated owner as the new owner of the contract. Emits an `OwnerClaimed` event with the address of the new owner.

params.inboundSwitchboard_: the address of switchboard to use for receiving messages
params.outboundSwitchboard_: the address of switchboard to use for sending messages
params.siblingPlug_: address of plug present at sibling chain to call inbound

params.messageDetails_: the details needed for message verification

params.msgGasLimit_: The gas limit of the message.
params.plug_: The address of the plug through which the message is sent.
params.remoteChainSlug_: The slug of the destination chain for the message.

returns.totalFees: The minimum fees required for the specified message.

params.plugAddress_: address of plug present at current chain

grantBatchRole(bytes32[],uint32[],addres.details: Grants multiple roles to multiple addresses in batch.

params.grantees_: The addresses to be granted the roles.
params.roleNames_: The names of the roles to grant.
params.slugs_: The slugs for chain specific roles. For roles which are not chain-specific, we can use slug = 0

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants a role to a given address.

params.grantee_: The address to grant the role to. Emits a RoleGranted event. Can only be called by the owner of the contract.

grantRoleWithSlug(bytes32,uint32,address.details: Grants a role to an address based on the role name and chain slug.

params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.
params.grantee_: The address to be granted the role.

hasRole(bytes32,address).details: Checks whether an address has a specific role.

returns._0: A boolean value indicating whether or not the address has the role.

hasRoleWithSlug(bytes32,uint32,address).details: Checks if an address has a role based on the role name and chain slug.

params.address_: The address to check for the role.
params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the address has the specified role.

isPacketProposed(bytes32).details: Checks whether the specified packet has been proposed.

params.packetId_: The ID of the packet to check.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the packet has been proposed or not.

nominateOwner(address).details: Allows the current owner to nominate a new owner for the contract. Throws an error if the caller is not the owner. Emits an `OwnerNominated` event with the address of the nominee.

nominee().details: Returns the current nominee for ownership of the contract.

outbound(uint32,uint256,bytes32,bytes).details: Packs the message and includes it in a packet with capacitor

params.msgGasLimit_: the gas limit needed to execute the payload on remote
params.payload_: the data which is needed by plug at inbound call on remote

owner().details: Returns the current owner of the contract.

params.siblingChainSlug_: The sibling chain slug to register the switchboard with

params.amount_: The amount of tokens to be rescued.
params.token_: The address of the token contract.
params.userAddress_: The address of the user who lost access to the funds.

revokeBatchRole(bytes32[],uint32[],addre.details: Revokes multiple roles from multiple addresses in batch.

params.grantees_: The addresses to be revoked the roles.
params.roleNames_: The names of the roles to revoke.
params.slugs_: The slugs for chain specific roles. For roles which are not chain-specific, we can use slug = 0

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes a role from a given address.

params.revokee_: The address to revoke the role from. Emits a RoleRevoked event. Can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.

params.batchSize_: size of batch to be sealed
